system.description:
The ancient Rituals of Night grant the Knower of Secrets power beyond the ken of his brethren. Through this skill, the Orc may cast spells listed under Rituals of Night.

Obstacles: See the Rituals of Night spell list. Spells must be purchased or learned separately.

FoRKs: Doctrine of Night’s Blood

Skill Type: Sorcerous. Tools: No.

Restrictions: Orcs only

Root: Perception (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 292
